question: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For each month, calculate the average composition for each interest by dividing the composition by the index value. Identify the interest with the highest average composition value each month and report its average composition as the max index composition for that month. Compute the three-month rolling average of these monthly max index compositions. Ensure the output includes the date, the interest name, the max index composition for that month, the rolling average, and the names and max index compositions of the top interests from one month ago and two months ago.
sql:
-- Full query with proper chronological ordering
WITH monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, composition, index_value, 
           AVG(composition / index_value) AS avg_composition
    FROM interest_metrics
    WHERE month_year IN ('09-2018','10-2018','11-2018','12-2018','01-2019','02-2019','03-2019','04-2019','05-2019','06-2019','07-2019','08-2019')
      AND month_year IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY month_year, interest_id, composition, index_value
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, avg_composition,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_composition DESC) as rn
    FROM monthly_avg
),
top_per_month AS (
    SELECT r.month_year, r.interest_id, r.avg_composition AS max_index_composition,
           CAST(SUBSTR(r.month_year, 5, 4) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(r.month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) AS sort_key
    FROM ranked r
    WHERE r.rn = 1
),
with_lags AS (
    SELECT 
        tpm.month_year,
        im.interest_name,
        tpm.max_index_composition,
        tpm.sort_key,
        AVG(tpm.max_index_composition) OVER (ORDER BY tpm.sort_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_3m,
        LAG(im.interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY tpm.sort_key) AS prev_month_interest,
        LAG(tpm.max_index_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY tpm.sort_key) AS prev_month_composition,
        LAG(im.interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY tpm.sort_key) AS prev_prev_month_interest,
        LAG(tpm.max_index_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY tpm.sort_key) AS prev_prev_month_composition
    FROM top_per_month tpm
    JOIN interest_map im ON tpm.interest_id = im.id
)
SELECT 
    month_year,
    interest_name,
    max_index_composition,
    rolling_avg_3m,
    prev_month_interest,
    prev_month_composition,
    prev_prev_month_interest,
    prev_prev_month_composition
FROM with_lags
ORDER BY sort_key
